title: read_graph specification
description: specification payload for action=read_graph (Blueprint domain, WS-06 P1).

graph_id.description: Graph within the target Blueprint asset, e.g. EventGraph or a function graph name. When omitted, the primary event graph is read.

include_dsl.description: When true, attach extensions.blueprint.dsl from Epic read_graph_dsl for debug only — not the agent contract.

response_detail_hint.description: Optional hint; authoritative gating is request.options.response_detail.
